newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Five farmers shot dead in southern Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Five farmers shot dead in southern Philippines.

text.p: Thirty heavily armed men shot dead five farmers and wounded four in the southern Philippines, the military said on Friday.
The attackers shot the farmers working in a remote area in North Cotabato province near Zamboanga, said Lieutenant General Romeo Padiernos, Armed Forces southern command chief.
The military said it was verifying reports the attackers were members of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), which officials blame for recent attacks on farmers in the area.
The MILF, with a fighting force estimated by the military at between 6,000 and 8,000, is fighting for an Islamic state in southern Mindanao island.
